args: Shopper authentication method mix: OAuth-linked vs password-only

Since shopper accounts have 0% MFA, what actually stands in for a second factor today — are most shoppers authenticating through an OAuth provider (Google/Apple/etc., which carries its own security), or are they overwhelmingly raw password-only accounts with no backup at all?
